pair_calibration.basis: maximum likelihood on earlier seasons' out-of-sample predictions

model.basis: eta = log expected regulation goals of the goalie-aware variant with its goalie term at zero; a pairing prices as exp(eta + goalie_beta × the opposing goalie's rating), pair-calibrated, through hockey/model/distribution.js

ratings.basis: hockey/model/ratings.js goalieRating: goals saved above expected per xG faced, decayed with the half-life and shrunk toward the replacement-level prior (the v1 rating; unchanged)
